Operations Manager at OUR GREENERY GmbH. Berlin. Apply for this Operations Manager opportunity through the original employer or job source.

Job Description

OUR GREENERY is redefining how fresh, nutritious food is produced and consumed. By combining innovative technology with a deep understanding of natural systems, we have developed the Raumgarten - a revolutionary solution that enables local, sustainable, and highly efficient food production. Circularity, efficiency, simplicity, and functional design are the foundation of everything we build. We believe that sustainable nutrition is one of the defining challenges of our generation. Our mission is to make healthy, fresh food accessible everywhere while fundamentally transforming the economics and environmental impact of food production. Since launching our first products, we have successfully proven the concept, built a talented team, and established strong market traction. We are now entering the next phase of growth. To support this next stage, we are looking for an experienced, pragmatic and hands-on Operations Manager. Tasks You will play a key role in building and scaling our hardware production. You will be responsible for the interface between product development, manufacturing, suppliers, purchasing, quality, inventory and management. Your goal is to transform our production from small-series manufacturing into a predictable, efficient and quality-controlled serial production setup. This role is not only about coordination, but also about industrialization, cost optimization, process development, supplier management and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities include: 1. Strategic Management &#x26; Optimization Operational leadership, with a focus on production and supplier management Scaling our production from one to multiple locations Ensuring high quality and targeting zero down time in our fleet Setting up a near to perfect quality control system after production 2. Financial Planning &#x26; Management Oversight of the financials including budgeting and controlling Optimization of purchasing conditions and cost management Ensuring financial stability while scaling Setup of a clear KPI driven reporting 3. Support Customer Growth Improvement of coordination and execution of our services for B2B clients Building efficient processes to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction 4. Team &#x26; Collaboration Building and leading a high-performing team across all fields Close collaboration with CEO &#x26; CTO to achieve strategic goals Direct responsibility with decision-making authority at the highest level You will work closely with the founding team and management, ensuring short communication paths and fast decision-making. Requirements What You Bring You have done it before. Experience in operations (COO / Co-Founding a company are welcome) that scaled a business to at least 7-figure revenue Experience with physical products and manufacturing them at scale Strong expertise in cost management, and operational efficiency A highly entrepreneurial mindset combined with a hands-on attitude Ability to achieve ambitious goals with limited resources and lean teams Passion for sustainable innovation and long-term commitment to the company’s vision Strong communication skills and the ability to inspire and lead people You know how to use various AI tools to increase productivity and strategy You do not need to know all the answers on Day 1. But you need to know how to find the answers, how to build the system that creates the results we want. Benefits What We Offer A core leadership role with significant responsibility and decision-making authority An attractive salary and equity package A modern working environment at the pulse of times The opportunity to work on solving a real, meaningful problem The chance to actively shape our vision and sustainably build a growing company A culture of openness, creativity, and collaboration A dynamic environment that enables fast decision-making and flexibility If this sounds like you and we’ve sparked your curiosity, apply with your full application and let us know your earliest possible start date.
